faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: What exactly is a Hatla2ee Credit?
faq.a1: Hatla2ee Credits are the currency you spend on advertising products like Turbo, Premium, Silver and Pump. One Hatla2ee Credit is worth one Egyptian pound at the standard rate, and a package simply gives you more of them for the same money.
faq.q2: How do bonus Hatla2ee Credits work?
faq.a2: The bonus is added on top of what you pay for. Expert adds 600 extra Hatla2ee Credits (20%) and Highline adds 1,120 (25%). Bonus Hatla2ee Credits behave exactly like paid ones and work on any product.
faq.q3: When are Hatla2ee Credits added to my account?
faq.a3: Instantly. The moment your payment is confirmed, the full balance including the bonus is in your wallet and ready to spend on your next ad.
faq.q4: How long do package Hatla2ee Credits stay valid?
faq.a4: Package Hatla2ee Credits are valid for 90 days from the date of purchase. You can see the remaining balance and the expiry date any time in your seller wallet.
faq.q5: Can I still top up the exact amount I need?
faq.a5: Yes. Pay-as-you-go top-ups are unchanged. Packages are simply an optional way to pay a lower rate per Hatla2ee Credit when you advertise regularly.
faq.a6: You can pay by Visa, Mastercard or Meeza, and through the local wallets supported at checkout. Every purchase includes a receipt you can download.
faq.a7: Unused package Hatla2ee Credits can be refunded within 14 days of purchase, as long as no bonus Hatla2ee Credits from that package have been spent. Contact support and we will return it to your original payment method.
